title: Eins, Zwei, Drei · LOOK MUM NO COMPUTER
description: The full video edit with original synth backing and physical voices.

melody.name: Eins, Zwei, Drei
melody.lyrics: So sick of doing the whole nine to five I pay my dues, I'm just staying alive And I'm so bored of it, bored of it Oh what's the point of it, point of it? A paracetamol to quench the pain The office cubicle has trapped me again Am I a mouse in a cage, am I? Duh duh duh demotivational Ah, if only there was a language That I could count in That would make me feel better Darling I need something salty With a slice of pepperoni I'll pay, you can owe me, that'll be a pony I'm coming back to life Got me feeling okey dokey Goodbye drudgery, hello me So light you can throw me, kill at karaoke I'm coming back to life Counting in English doesn't cut the mustard So sick of munching roly poly with custard I'm so bored with it, bored with it Oh what's the point of it, point of it? I've always been a fan of aviation I'm jumping on a plane to another nation All my pounds, they feel counterfeit I need some euros to counter it Darling I need something salty With a slice of pepperoni I'll pay, you can owe me, that'll be a pony I'm coming back to life Got me feeling okey dokey Goodbye drudgery, hello me So light you can throw me, kill at karaoke I'm coming back to life Darling I need something salty With a slice of pepperoni I'll pay, you can owe me, that'll be a pony I'm coming back to life Darling I need something salty With a slice of pepperoni I'll pay, you can owe me, that'll be a pony I'm coming back to life I'm coming back to life
